# Ezekiel 37 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 37:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-looked, and-behold — upon-them sinews, and-flesh came-up, and-skin spread over-them from-above; but-breath [was] not in-them. |
| LOGOS | And I looked, and behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh had come upon them, and skin had covered them. But there was no breath in them. |
| PNEUMA | As I watched, muscles and flesh formed over the bones, and then skin covered them. But they still had no breath in them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 37:20 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-sticks on-which you-write will-be in-your-hand before-their-eyes. |
| LOGOS | When the sticks on which you write are in your hand before their eyes, |
| PNEUMA | Hold the sticks up where the people can see them, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 37:2 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-caused-me-to-pass over-them all-around, and-behold, very many [were] on-the-surface-of the-valley, and-behold, [they-were] very dry. |
| LOGOS | And He led me around among them, and behold, there were very many on the surface of the valley, and behold, they were very dry. |
| PNEUMA | He led me all around among the bones, and I saw that there were an enormous number of them scattered across the valley floor — and they were completely dried out. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 37:23 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-will-not-defile-themselves anymore with-their-idols and-with-their-detestable-things and-with-all their-transgressions; and-I-will-save-them from-all their-dwelling-places in-which they-sinned, and-I-will-cleanse-them; and-they-will-be to-Me a-people, and-I will-be to-them God. |
| LOGOS | They shall not defile themselves anymore with their idols and their detestable things, or with any of their transgressions. But I will save them from all the backslidings in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God. |
| PNEUMA | They will never again defile themselves with idols, vile images, or rebellion. I will save them from their sinful apostasy and cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 37:26 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-make for-them a-covenant-of peace; an-everlasting-covenant it-will-be with-them; and-I-will-place-them and-multiply-them and-put My-sanctuary in-their-midst forever. |
| LOGOS | I will make a covenant of peace with them. It shall be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will set them in their land and multiply them, and will set My sanctuary in their midst forevermore. |
| PNEUMA | I will make a covenant of peace with them — an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my Temple among them forever. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 37:5 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Thus says the-Lord YHWH to-these bones: Behold-Me bringing into-you breath, and-you-will-live. |
| LOGOS | Thus says the Lord GOD to these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter you, and you shall live. |
| PNEUMA | This is what the Sovereign LORD says to you: I am going to breathe life into you, and you will come alive! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
